card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 106 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 15.4 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, AV Sgr: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 106.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,453 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, AV Sgr: Per, Rad, Dist
